description: Prompt for reading the health reports — and the disk report, when the disk is low (ASS-288) — and deciding whether a fix is needed now

needs-fix.description: true if any report found a real problem

summary.description: The problem in one line, 120 characters or fewer

blocks-tickets.description: true if the problem blocks, or will block, sprint tickets

must-interrupt-work.description: true if fixing it means pausing agent work on a shared resource

can-continue-without-fix.description: true if the highest-priority workable ticket can still progress without the fix
